selection: Retrospective diagnostic development on the known KITTI01/02 failures. Existing fixed plane/elevation values selected on07;00 influenced prior diagnosis. No held-out or improvement claim.
cases: Exactly every pair in committed inten_seed_intervention cases.json, same order, including every inherited bad S2S/final length step and neighbours, plus first and 100-step block endpoints. No new case/threshold selection.
intervention: Actual target/source feature coordinates and every ground/facade nearest-neighbour query at the unchanged current-GT seed. Use the verbatim native plane lambda, public feature extractor and unchanged feature tree; verify all class counts/H/g and final S2S outputs against the parent oracle before analysis. No native API or estimator change.
controls: Offline fixed-association first-system controls: replace ground normals with the PCA normal of the SAME in-gate 10-NN set, (1) through original nearest point, (2) through neighbourhood centroid. Recompute H/g/Huber weights with identical support; edge, facade and intensity stay unchanged. Numerical PCA degeneracy lambda_middle <= 1e-12*lambda_largest keeps original residual. These are outside-paper diagnostic interventions, not full iterative solves or a proposed estimator.
params: Existing paper_odometry_plane_check fixed params, acceleratedfalse; only use_mappingfalse for the isolated pair diagnostic, identical in every mode. No estimator/default/runner API changes.
data: Official fetch_kitti_odometry_sequences.py, one full sequence at a time. Check all input hashes against committed natural-trace inputs before execution and deletion. Retain failures and stop on control mismatch; delete only owned scans after validated evidence is archived and committed.
report: Compare all selected pairs, inherited natural-bad vs other moving groups, and every parent oracle failure/entry. Report fixed first-update changes under both controls, including adverse cases. Do not equate a first-step change with recovery or full-trajectory accuracy.
limits: Retrospective diagnostic development on known failures, not held out. GT may have timing/calibration errors. Conditional attribution is not a class-removal experiment. PCA controls change local plane representation only in an offline fixed-system diagnostic; no reassociation or recursive trajectory. A separately validated opt-in candidate and KITTI10 drift remain open.
geometry_report: Every correspondence retained. Reconstruct the native triangle from same/adjacent-row selections. Continuous distributions only: triangle sine, triangle/PCA normal angle, PCA eigenvalue ratios, oriented-up ground normal radial tilt, residual, and each residual contribution to first sensor-origin motion through the same total damped H. No fitted gate or significance test.
